title: Choco automates food distribution with AI agents
summary: How Choco used OpenAI APIs to streamline food distribution, boost productivity, and unlock growth—an in-depth customer story on real-world AI impact.
body: How Choco used OpenAI APIs to streamline food distribution, boost productivity, and unlock growth—an in-depth customer story on real-world AI impact.
summaryZh: Choco通过集成OpenAI API构建AI Agent，实现了食品分销流程的自动化。该案例展示了AI如何通过处理订单与库存数据，显著提升供应链生产力并降低人工干预成本。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该案例展示了AI Agent在传统物流与分销行业的具体落地场景，具有参考意义。
